task_description: Deterministic formula surrogate approximating BIS IS 10500:2012 Weighted Arithmetic Water Quality Index and Permissible Limit Exceedances from geochemical ion measurements.
disclaimer: Models wqi_regressor_v1.booster and water_hazard_v1.booster are deterministic surrogates learning the Weighted Arithmetic WQI from chemical ion concentrations. They do not predict future groundwater quality changes or hydrological contaminant transport.
